name: Westminster City Council

departments.name: Licensing
departments.notes: Largest licensing authority in the UK. Processes over 9,000 licence applications per year. Weekly 'Licensing News' bulletin available via email. Contact licensing@westminster.gov.uk to subscribe.

departments.name: Street Trading
departments.notes: Same phone number (020 7641 7010) used for booking casual trading pitches.

departments.name: Planning
departments.notes: Applications submitted via the national Planning Portal. Paper applications accepted by post but take longer to process. Online search and comment system available for public consultation.

departments.name: Building Control
departments.notes: Online application system for full plans, building notice, and regularisation applications. Out of hours working approval also available.

departments.name: Highways
departments.notes: Traffic Management Orders (TMOs) searchable online by street name or ward. Permit scheme introduced January 2010 - all highway works require permits. Major works require 3 month advance notice. Notice periods: 2 hours for emergency works to 28 days for planned works.

departments.name: Health and Safety
departments.notes: Covers offices, leisure venues, food shops, supermarkets, restaurants, pubs, hotels, and places of worship. Also handles lifts, boilers, pressure vessels, and recreational water sampling.

researchNotes: Research conducted via Westminster City Council website and public search results. Largest licensing authority in the UK with 14+ staff processing 9,000+ applications annually. Planning applications handled via national Planning Portal rather than council-specific system.
